page.layout: One page, a title-style ownership page: a printed stamp at top left (not transcribed as text), then centred printed lines in the middle of the page. No running text, no notes, no margins with printed text.
page.notes: The stamp at top left (an octagonal star-shaped stamp with the numbers 6, 28, 63 and the words "Vittorio Emanuele" in the corners) and the handwritten marks (11-E-31, 3.51, N D 5.4 and similar) are not printed text and are omitted. The "22. ɔ" line is handwritten in the scan and is transcribed as it appears; it may be a manuscript shelf mark rather than print and could be left out. Show-through and scan edge marks are ignored.
